title: Getting Started with dsOMOP v2
text: dsOMOP v2 provides typed interface OMOP Common Data Model databases DataSHIELD framework. server implements endpoint-specific disclosure controls, deployment safety also depends complete method allowlist, policy options, database role downstream consumers. consists two packages: dsOMOP (server-side): runs DataSHIELD node. Handles database queries, disclosure control, data preparation. dsOMOPClient (client-side): runs local machine. Provides ergonomic API schema exploration, cohort management, data extraction.

Merge row-bind can increase row counts (person-key join can multiply longitudinal rows), analysts must still choose intended grain. distinct-person gate reapplied verbs fail closed support insufficient. call returns (invisibly) name new server-side symbol, can feed reviewed verbs, ds.omop.cohort.from_table(), allowlisted analysis method explicitly supports object’s grain protected columns. code: # Join two token-keyed frames on the person key (only the person key is allowed) joined <- ds.omop.merge("baseline", "labs", by = "person_id", type = "left",   symbol = "omop", conns = conns)  # Keep broad categories; numeric/date ranges belong in the recipe filter DSL women <- ds.omop.filter("baseline", var = "sex", op = "==", value = "F",   symbol = "omop", conns = conns)  # Project to a subset of columns (the person token is always retained) slim <- ds.omop.select(joined, cols = c("age", "gender_concept_id"),   symbol = "omop", conns = conns)  # Row-bind two schema-identical frames; the gate counts DISTINCT persons, # so binding a frame to itself cannot inflate the count past the threshold stacked <- ds.omop.bind_rows("wave1", "wave2", symbol = "omop", conns = conns)

title: Data Extraction with the Plan DSL
text: extraction plan DSL specifies typed subset data transformations OMOP CDM. plan serializable object describing cohort, one outputs, representations, global options. Plans built client-side, inspected server schema, executed produce server-side omop.table objects. raw SQL permit arbitrary joins output schemas. higher-level, named, save/loadable extractions, recipe API wraps plan (covered end vignette).

title: Data Extraction with the Plan DSL
code: library(dsOMOPClient)  plan <- ds.omop.plan() plan <- ds.omop.plan.cohort(plan,   spec = list(type = "condition", concept_set = c(201826))) # Concept translation and federation-wide concept factors are ON by default # (translate_concepts = TRUE, factor_concepts = TRUE). This example adds an # inline index cohort because baseline/episode outputs need one.

title: Data Extraction with the Plan DSL
text: ds.omop.plan.baseline() adds cohort-episode-level output demographic columns person table, plus optional derived columns (e.g. age_at_index): Baseline requires cohort emits one row per cohort episode. Raw birth components blocked; age_at_index returned controller’s public age grid rather year_of_birth exact completed age. merge reviewed one-row-per-person tables, use ds.omop.plan.person_level(): Raw person-level sources limited person death; repeatable tables measurements, visits observation periods must requested events reduced explicitly features. compiler pick one several records implicitly.
code: plan <- ds.omop.plan.baseline(plan,   columns = c("gender_concept_id", "race_concept_id"),   derived = c("age_at_index"),   name = "demographics") plan <- ds.omop.plan.person_level(plan,   tables = list(     person = c("gender_concept_id", "race_concept_id"),     death = c("cause_concept_id")),   name = "person_data")

title: Data Extraction with the Plan DSL
text: event output uses one four representations explicit row grain: long (default): one row per qualifying event , index window, per event/episode match. Raw date columns removed default; request relative binned handling explicitly. wide: pivots concept column grain = "person" (default) grain = "episode". one event per grain/concept rejected; use deterministic event_select feature reduction first. Federated wide output additionally requires closed integer concept_set translate_concepts = FALSE: every declared concept produces concept-ID-derived column every node, including -NA column absent locally, undeclared concepts enter output. features: explicit reducers (counts, ever-flags, mean/sd, first/latest, durations, etc.) person episode grain. index_window wide features requires grain = "episode", preserving cohort_row_id. sparse: FeatureExtraction-style covariate triplets person grain , index_window, episode grain. complete personRef maps rowId pseudonymized person , episode grain, cohort_row_id; missing covariate row means implicit zero.
code: plan <- ds.omop.plan.options(plan, translate_concepts = FALSE) plan <- ds.omop.plan.events(plan, name = "labs_wide",   table = "measurement", concept_set = c(3004410),   temporal = omop.temporal(     index_window = list(start = -365L, end = 0L),     event_select = list(order = "last", n = 1L)),   representation = list(format = "wide", grain = "episode"))

title: Data Extraction with the Plan DSL
text: lower-level plan API also provides: Overlapping episodes can legitimately repeat one clinical event different cohort_row_id values. event_select applied per episode index window present, otherwise per person. selects globally within grain default. Set event_select = list(order = "first", n = 1, = "concept") independent first/last-N selection per concept, use explicit first_value/latest_value feature reducers concept-set-specific values. min_gap = 30L chains -concept events 30 days apart; full policy can declare list(days = 30L, = "concept", keep = "first"). Collapse per cohort episode index window present uses standard OMOP event primary key break -date ties deterministically. basic regular person-period panel available ds.omop.plan.person_period() Recipe output type = "person_period". emits personPeriods, temporalCovariates, covariateRef, timeRef, personRef; missing sparse tuples zeros. intentionally requires episode grain index-relative bins emits neither absolute dates raw event identifiers. Explicit censoring/risk-interval semantics general counting-process, recurrent-event competing-risk/multi-state models remain future work. Multi-table long recipes split one output per table rather fabricating arbitrary cross-table join. Representations expand request subject controller-configurable operational caps. defaults allow 1,000 explicit feature specifications (dsomop.max_feature_specs), 1,000 concepts expanded wide/sparse/temporal output (dsomop.max_pivot_concepts), 5,000 final wide/feature columns (dsomop.max_output_columns) 10,000 temporal bins window (dsomop.max_temporal_bins). Filter trees capped depth 32, 1,024 nodes 10,000 literal values, plan 100 outputs. controller-configurable memory/CPU safeguards rather disclosure guarantees. Across servers, construct request within lowest compatible cap advertised every participating site.

title: Data Extraction with the Plan DSL
text: Use omop.date_handling() make temporal precision explicit: mode = "remove" default removes every date/datetime column; mode = "relative" emits integer days cohort index replaces index date zero; mode = "binned" emits calendar year, month Monday-based week bins; mode = "absolute" keeps raw dates controller enabled dsomop.allow_absolute_dates. opt-make raw dates harmless. exact dates disabled, selecting date columns conversion leave others untouched. Datetimes converted using controller-owned timezone. Raw birth year/month/day blocked. Derived age annual-resolution reference_year - year_of_birth released controller’s public age grid; birthday-aware completed age. Closed age/date filters must meet configured minimum widths, age-group labels must unions public grid. federation negotiates stricter common contract described Multi-Server vignette.
code: plan <- ds.omop.plan.events(   plan, name = "relative_conditions", table = "condition_occurrence",   concept_set = c(201826),   temporal = omop.temporal(index_window = list(start = -365L, end = 30L)),   date_handling = omop.date_handling(mode = "relative", reference = "index") )

title: Data Extraction with the Plan DSL
text: Beyond concept set, ds.omop.plan.events() accepts filters argument takes nested /tree row-level predicates. Build leaves omop_filter* constructors combine omop_filter_group(..., operator = "" | ""): Disclosure note: custom filter DSL fail-closed. Categories use reviewed membership/null predicates (, not_in, is_null, not_null); dates use bounded range satisfies controller’s minimum width. Exact matches client-authored ordered thresholds (==, !=, >=, >, <=, <) rejected server-side. Numeric filtering uses authenticated value_bin whose public grid configured controller issued current resource session. Filtering person token protected / identifier column also rejected, distinct-person gate still runs filtered result. Use ds.omop.safe.filter.value() row filters ds.omop.safe.filter.measurement() population-level measurement range.
code: lab_bin <- ds.omop.safe.filter.value(   table = "measurement",   column = "value_as_number",   threshold = 6.5,   direction = "above",   concept_id = 3004410,   symbol = "omop",   conns = conns )  filt <- omop_filter_group(   lab_bin,   omop_filter_date_range(start = "2020-01-01", end = "2023-12-31"),   operator = "AND")  plan <- ds.omop.plan.events(plan, name = "labs_filtered",   table = "measurement", concept_set = c(3004410),   filters = filt)

title: Data Extraction with the Plan DSL
text: ds.omop.plan.preview() sends plan schema/structure preview returns per-server declared columns banded source-table support indicator without creating assignment outputs: person count returned honestly countable unscoped, unfiltered, unreduced source. what: Build a date handling specification — omop.date_handling
title: Build a date handling specification — omop.date_handling
text: Creates specification controlling date columns transformed event-level outputs. Dates can kept -, converted relative days index date, binned calendar periods, removed entirely privacy.

title: Build a date handling specification — omop.date_handling
code: omop.date_handling(   mode = "remove",   reference = "index",   bin_width = NULL,   date_columns = NULL )

title: Build a date handling specification — omop.date_handling
text: mode Character; transformation mode. Defaults "remove" (privacy-preserving). One "absolute" (keep original dates), "relative" (convert days reference), "binned" (aggregate calendar bins), "remove" (drop date columns). reference Character; reference point relative mode. Currently "index" (cohort index date) supported. bin_width Character; bin granularity binned mode. One "week", "month", "year". date_columns Character vector; specific date columns transform. NULL, date columns output transformed.

title: Build a date handling specification — omop.date_handling
text: list elements mode, reference,   bin_width, date_columns.

title: Build a date handling specification — omop.date_handling

title: Build a temporal filtering specification — omop.temporal
text: index_window Named list start end (integer days relative cohort index date). Negative values denote time index date. calendar Named list start end (character ISO 8601 dates, e.g. "2020-01-01"). event_select Named list order ("first" "last"), n (integer; number events), optional = "grain" (default) = "concept". Concept mode keeps first/last N independently concept within cohort episode index_window present, otherwise within person. min_gap Positive integer days, named list days, optional = "concept" "grain", optional keep = "first" "last". Adjacent events days apart form one chain. normalized policy defaults concept-specific chains represented first event.

title: Create a filter specification — omop_filter
text: Filters restrict population events included extraction. two executable levels: "population" (person-level inclusion criteria) "row" (event-level restrictions). Post-extraction transformations belong output specification rather filter; retired "output" filter level rejected. Filters passed omop_recipe via filters argument can nested groups omop_filter_group.

title: Create a filter specification — omop_filter
code: omop_filter(   type = c("sex", "age_range", "age_group", "cohort", "has_concept", "not_has_concept",     "concept_count", "prior_observation", "followup", "visit_count", "has_measurement",     "missing_measurement", "date_range", "concept_set", "value_bin", "value_concept",     "custom"),   level = c("population", "row"),   params = list(),   label = NULL )  omop_filter_sex(value)  omop_filter_age(min = 0, max = 150, year = NULL, reference_date = NULL)  omop_filter_age_group(groups, year = NULL, reference_date = NULL)  omop_filter_cohort(cohort_definition_id)  omop_filter_has_concept(   concept_id,   table,   concept_name = NULL,   window = NULL,   min_count = 1L,   reference_date = NULL )  omop_filter_date_range(start = NULL, end = NULL, date_column = NULL)  omop_filter_value(   column = "value_as_number",   threshold,   direction = c("above", "below"),   safe_bins = NULL )  omop_filter_value_concept(   concept_ids,   column = "value_as_concept_id",   concept_name = NULL )  omop_filter_not_has_concept(   concept_id,   table,   concept_name = NULL,   window = NULL,   reference_date = NULL )  omop_filter_concept_count(   concept_id,   table,   min_count = 2L,   concept_name = NULL,   window = NULL,   reference_date = NULL )  omop_filter_prior_observation(min_days = 365L, reference_date = NULL)  omop_filter_followup(min_days = 30L, reference_date = NULL)  omop_filter_visit_count(   min_count = 1L,   visit_concept_id = NULL,   window = NULL,   reference_date = NULL )  omop_filter_has_measurement(   concept_id,   min_value = NULL,   max_value = NULL,   safe_bins = NULL,   window = NULL,   reference_date = NULL )  omop_filter_missing_measurement(   concept_id,   window = NULL,   reference_date = NULL )

title: Create a filter specification — omop_filter
text: type Character; executable filter type. Population filters "sex", "age_range", "age_group", "cohort", "has_concept", "not_has_concept", "concept_count", "prior_observation", "followup", "visit_count", "has_measurement", "missing_measurement". Row filters "date_range", "concept_set", "value_bin", "value_concept", fail-closed typed "custom" predicate. level Character; "population" "row". omitted, unique executable level type selected. Output-level filters part executable Recipe contract. params Named list; filter-specific parameters (varies type). label Character NULL; human-readable description (auto-generated type params NULL). value Character; sex value. Accepts "F", "f", "female", "Female", "FEMALE", "M", "m", "male", "Male", "MALE" — normalized internally "F" "M". min Numeric; minimum age (inclusive) max Numeric; maximum age (inclusive) year Integer NULL; explicit calendar-year anchor (shorthand July 1 year). cohort index supplies anchor omitted. reference_date Date/string NULL; fixed anchor window population cohort index. index used omitted. groups Character vector; age group labels (e.g. c("18-24", "25-34")) cohort_definition_id Integer; existing OMOP cohort_definition_id require membership. concept_id Integer scalar vector; measurement concept ID(s) check absence (vector requires absent) table Character; OMOP table check concept_name Character NULL; human-readable name window Named list start/end index-relative day offsets, NULL; restricts absence window (e.g. "HbA1c prior year") min_count Integer; minimum number visits start Character; inclusive start date ISO YYYY-MM-DD form. end Character; inclusive end date ISO YYYY-MM-DD form start. server applies authoritative minimum disclosure-safe width configured data controller. date_column Character NULL; explicit OMOP date column. NULL, recipe_to_plan infers standard date column output's OMOP table. column Character; value-concept column (default "value_as_concept_id") threshold Numeric; threshold value direction Character; "" "" safe_bins Server-issued result measurement concept ds.omop.safe.cutpoints(). Required whenever numeric range supplied; client-authored thresholds executable. concept_ids Integer scalar vector; value concept(s) keep (record matches value concept ) min_days Integer; minimum days followup visit_concept_id Integer scalar vector, NULL; visit type filter (vector counts visits given types) min_value Numeric NULL; minimum value max_value Numeric NULL; maximum value

title: Create an output specification — omop_output
text: name Character; output table name (used key recipe). type Character; output layout type. One "wide", "long", "features", "survival", "intervals", "baseline", "temporal_covariates", "person_period". "long" output spans multiple source tables always splits one per-table output (named <name>_<table>); single cross-table joined frame. former "joined_long" "covariates_sparse" recipe labels rejected faithful executable mapping; use split "long" outputs lower-level temporal-covariates plan API. variables Character vector NULL; variable names include (NULL means variables recipe). population_id Character; population use (default "base"). options Named list; type-specific options (e.g. tar survival outputs). result_symbol Character NULL; R symbol name result server (auto-generated D_<name> NULL).

title: Create a population node — omop_population
text: id Character; population ID (must unique within recipe). label Character; human-readable label. parent_id Character NULL; parent population ID (NULL root). Informational provenance ; set-op membership executable dependency. filters List omop_filter omop_filter_group objects (criteria populations ). cohort_definition_id Integer NULL; base cohort definition ID (population defined pre-existing cohort). episode_policy Character NULL; explicit semantics index-dependent filters index cohort can contain multiple episodes per person. what: Create an extraction recipe declaratively — omop_recipe
title: Create an extraction recipe declaratively — omop_recipe
text: recipe central user-facing data structure OMOP data extraction. holds every selection one place: populations (), variable blocks (, grouped), individual variables, filters (constraints), outputs (shape result), base cohort, plan-wide options.

title: Create an extraction recipe declaratively — omop_recipe
code: omop_recipe(   variables = NULL,   filters = NULL,   outputs = NULL,   populations = NULL,   blocks = NULL,   cohort = NULL,   tables = NULL,   combine = "union",   options = NULL,   output = NULL )

title: Create an extraction recipe declaratively — omop_recipe
text: variables single omop_variable (including convenience omop_variable_* derived constructors) list . filters single omop_filter / omop_filter_group list . named list uses name filter ID. outputs single omop_output list . populations single omop_population list (implicit "base" population always exists; parents must declared children). blocks single omop_variable_block list ; block expanded individual variables. cohort Recipe-level scope. form – scalar OMOP cohort_definition_id, cohort handle (dsomop_cohort_handle), server-side cohort table name – resolves gated person set intersected every population (alongside tables). re-root base population; build base population existing cohort use omop_population(cohort_definition_id = ...). NULL sets scope. tables Character vector server-side omop.table symbol names, NULL. distinct persons form recipe-level scope folded cohort scope combine intersected every population (server resolves symbol names frames). combine Character; fold multiple scope sources together: "union" (default) "intersect". options Named list plan-wide options (translate_concepts, block_sensitive, factor_concepts); supplied keys override defaults. output Convenience alias single omop_output; use instead outputs recipe just one output.

title: Create an extraction recipe declaratively — omop_recipe
text: omop_recipe object.

title: Create an extraction recipe declaratively — omop_recipe
text: single recipe-authoring entry point: pass complete extraction one nested expression built leaf constructors (omop_variable, omop_filter, omop_output, omop_population, omop_variable_block, friends). argument accepts single object list objects. recipe assembled dependency order (populations, blocks, variables, filters, outputs, base cohort, options) later items can reference earlier ones. users work recipe level recipe_preview, recipe_execute, recipe_save, recipe_load; recipe_to_plan exposes lower-level execution contract sent server.

title: Create an extraction recipe declaratively — omop_recipe
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ recipe <- omop_recipe(   blocks = omop_variable_block(     table = "condition_occurrence",     concept_ids = c(201820),     format = "binary"   ),   variables = list(     omop_variable_age(),     omop_variable(table = "measurement", concept_id = 3004410,                   format = "mean")   ),   filters = omop_filter_sex("F"),   outputs = omop_output(name = "study", type = "wide") ) recipe_execute(recipe)  # Multi-population: build two criteria subgroups, UNION them into one # population, then run an output against that union while a recipe-level # scope (a cohort handle INTERSECTED with a workspace omop.table's persons) # narrows every population. recipe2 <- omop_recipe(   populations = list(     omop_population("diabetic", "Diabetics",                     filters = list(omop_filter_has_concept(                       201820, "condition_occurrence"))),     omop_population("hypertensive", "Hypertensives",                     filters = list(omop_filter_has_concept(                       320128, "condition_occurrence"))),     omop_population("either", "Diabetic or hypertensive",                     union = c("diabetic", "hypertensive"))   ),   variables = omop_variable_age(),   outputs = omop_output(name = "study", type = "wide",                         population_id = "either"),   cohort = my_cohort_handle,   # cohort handle / table name as scope   tables = "my_inclusion_set", # workspace omop.table symbol name   combine = "intersect" ) recipe_execute(recipe2)  # `cohort=` is ALWAYS scope, including a bare cohort_definition_id: it resolves # to a gated person set that narrows every population. To instead BUILD the base # population from an existing admin/ATLAS cohort, pass it through # omop_population(cohort_definition_id = ...); `cohort=` then layers a scope on # top. recipe3 <- omop_recipe(   populations = omop_population(id = "base", label = "Registry cohort",                                 cohort_definition_id = 1001),  # base population   variables = omop_variable_age(),   outputs = omop_output(name = "study", type = "wide"),   cohort = 2002                                               # scalar id = scope ) recipe_execute(recipe3) } # }

title: Create a variable specification — omop_variable
text: name Character; output column name (auto-generated concept_name, concept_id, column NULL). table Character; source OMOP CDM table (e.g. "condition_occurrence"). column Character NULL; source column extract. concept_id Integer NULL; concept ID filter (concept columns). concept_name Character NULL; human-readable concept name. type Character; variable type hint. One "auto", "numeric", "categorical", "date", "boolean", "integer", "character". format Character; output format. One "raw", "binary", "count", "first_value", "last_value", "mean", "min", "max", "time_since", plus documented derived longitudinal summary formats. "time_since" requires fixed reference_date; cohort-index recency remains episode-specific rejected. Calendar binning configured omop.date_handling, variable format. value_source Character NULL; column extract value (e.g. "value_as_number" measurements). time_window Named list start/end offsets relative index date, NULL window constraint. suffix_mode Character; name multi-column expansions ("index", "range", "label"). filters List omop_filter objects apply variable. visit_filter Named list list(concept_ids = ...) NULL; restrict variable's events visits visit_concept_id values (via visit_occurrence_id link). concept_col Character NULL; override concept column concept_id/concept set scopes (default: table's domain concept), e.g. "unit_concept_id" extract single unit harmonization. expand Logical; TRUE, expand concept include vocabulary descendants server-side (default FALSE). reference_date Character/Date NULL; fixed ISO reference date required format = "time_since". unit Character NULL; "day" (default time_since) "month". Months complete calendar months, fixed 30-day intervals.

Direct dsOMOP     plans also support ; Circe rejected Circe subsequently     applies ERA collapse dsOMOP preserves individual episodes. omop_filter_has_concept -> InclusionRule occurrence criteria;     never implicitly promoted entry event. omop_filter_not_has_concept -> InclusionRule occurrence     "exactly 0" criteria. omop_filter_concept_count -> InclusionRule occurrence "    least N" criteria. Presence-omop_filter_has_measurement -> Measurement     criteria. Numeric bounds rejected Circe carry     DataSHIELD-issued safe-bin contract. omop_filter_sex / omop_filter_age -> DemographicCriteria     Gender / Age. Filter window = list(start, end) day offsets -> criteria     StartWindow (index-relative days). omop_filter_prior_observation / omop_filter_followup ->     entry event ObservationWindow (PriorDays / PostDays). omop_filter_group(operator = "") -> nested Circe     CriteriaGroup Type ; population's top-level criteria map     cohort's implicit . Intentionally unsupported (rejected, never silently lost): set-operation populations, cohort_definition_id references, fixed-reference ages/windows, age_group, visit_count, missing_measurement, value_bin / value_concept / date_range (row-level) filters, recipe variable/output layer. Circe-end/censor strategies, non-start windows, unsupported occurrence operators, multiple primary criteria, nested groups rejected import.
